hypotheses.name: Division provenance

hypotheses.name: Net cost/performance
hypotheses.proposed_counterfactual: Full positive costs including power and waste

hypotheses.name: Functional heredity

hypotheses.falsifier: Distinct beneficial genotypes with demonstrated inherited functions and randomised lineage controls

hypotheses.name: Independent founder count
hypotheses.proposed_counterfactual: One propagated lineage with machine iterations
hypotheses.falsifier: Multiple unscreened founders and failure-inclusive independent daughter pedigrees

hypotheses.falsifier: New challenge learning with paid sensing/history beating reactive/memory-disabled/shuffled controls

hypotheses.name: Novel beneficial function

decision: Use as positive technical benchmark for DNA heredity under operator-driven fission; reject as evidence for autonomous reproductive or constructor closure
